entities.name: St Michael's Chapel
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: St Michael's Chapel was a place of worship at Wawel Castle in Kraków, Poland. It was both a royal chapel and the chapel of the commoners. The chapel was governed by the dean and canons of Wawel.
